findings.label: Parallel workers don't send the header
findings.detail: Menagerie parallel_tasks workers using saved mode profiles omit X-OmniRoute-Tier, so they still escalate. Follow up in menagerie (inject live omniRouteTier in getTaskHandoffContext/runParallelTasks; stop persisting it in saveConfig).

findings.label: No Retry-After on tier-ceiling 503
findings.detail: Zero-admitted 503 passes no retryAfter; consider a short Retry-After since the cause is usually local saturation.

findings.label: Flatten-mode grandchild refs not re-filtered
findings.detail: Tiered combo-refs nested inside an admitted pool escape the ceiling in flatten mode; inert with today's model-only pools.

findings.label: Busy path tested via 503 stub
findings.detail: Tier-1 failure is simulated by a 503 from handleSingleModel, not the runtime-unit concurrency cap; a capacity-cap case would pin the real symptom.
